reason: A media-processing plugin that uploads local or linked audio/video to an external service for multilingual translation, voice-cloned dubbing, status polling, and result retrieval.

summaries.zh: 将本地或链接中的音频、视频配音翻译成多种语言，并通过远程服务返回配音结果。
summaries.en: Dubs local or linked audio and video into supported languages through a remote service and returns the processed result.

capabilities: Reads local audio or video files
Uploads media to an external dubbing service
Translates spoken content and generates cloned-voice dubs
Polls remote dubbing jobs and retrieves result links
